description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableMeasurement' that implements the 'Measurement' interface. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, converting instances to JSON, and encapsulates metrics data such as success status, metric type, timing values, and last message timestamp.

classes.name: ImmutableMeasurement
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'Measurement' interface, encapsulating metric data such as type, success status, values, and timestamp.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the metric type of the measurement.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the measurement was successful.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Returns the map of duration-based counts.

methods.name: getLastMessageAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last message, if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the measurement instance to a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMeasurement instance from a JSON object, parsing all relevant fields.
